method.sampling: vertices+triangle centroids+edge midpoints of each mesh vs the other mesh; inside by 3-direction ray-parity majority; depth = distance to nearest opposing surface
method.depth_note: Signed depths are negative inside, conditional on ray-parity sign; sample maxima do not upper-bound unsampled penetration. No CAD chord error, tolerance or continuous moving-gear fit certification. Split/non-manifold geometry and ray disagreements limit solid interpretation.
